name: Loading Button
description: Pill-shaped progress button that draws its outline as a loading bar with a spinner and percentage, supports pause and resume, then fills in with an animated double check and a Done label.
contents: Outlined rounded button with spinner and percentage counter
Done state with animated double check, label and reset button
behavior: Starts automatically after a delay and progresses with an ease-in-out curve
Border stroke fills as progress advances
Pause button swaps with a play icon using a slide and fade
On completion the button fills with the accent color and the checks draw in
editableByProps: Duration, start delay and auto start
Accent, pause, surface and check colors
fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Button size is fixed at 212 by 62 pixels
